title: 人工规则能推动进食，但循环仍在
criterion: 人工计划至少吃到一份，且同 seed 基线没有进食
selection: 符合条件的局按食物数、seed、repeat 排序，取中位项。展示机制，不估计总体收益。

plan.plan_text: Locate the head and direction arrow on each new screenshot. Map relative actions to adjacent cells and exclude immediate wall or non-tail body collisions. The pointed tail vacates on a non-eating move. Among safe actions, prefer a move approaching the food. Recheck the image after each move rather than repeating the previous action automatically.
